exact_signature:
theorem actual_affine_precision_query {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d)
    {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 2 ≤ κ)
    (O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin d) ℝ) :
    let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
    let A : ℝ → Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := fun η =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ) *
        Matrix.diagonal (fun i => (η + 1) / 2 + (η - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)) *
        (O : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ).transpose
    let query : ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) :=
      fun η x => WithLp.toLp 2 (A η *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)
    ∀ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d),
      query κ x = (κ - 1) • query 2 x - (κ - 2) • x ∧
      query 2 x = (κ - 1)⁻¹ • (query κ x + (κ - 2) • x)

The source rotation lies in the full real O(d). orthogonalGroup is unitaryGroup under trivial scalar star; unitaryGroup is unitary matrices; carrier is transpose(O)*O=I and O*transpose(O)=I. On square finite real matrices this is equivalent to the source convention transpose(O)*O=I. No determinant-sign restriction, affine relation, spectral estimate or accessibility premise is contained.
Every vector of the same finite real Euclidean carrier, represented as PiLp 2 over Fin d; no exclusion of zero.
